MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 0
   D. 16

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 14

3. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 15

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 17
   C. 12
   D. 5

5. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 41
   D. 13

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 5

9. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 2

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

11. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

14. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 32

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

16. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
